name: Does siding staining offer protection against weather and pests?

mainEntity.name: Does siding staining offer protection against weather and pests?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, siding staining provides significant protection for your wood siding. Stains penetrate the wood fibers, offering a barrier against moisture intrusion, which can lead to rot and mildew. They also contain UV inhibitors that protect against sun damage, preventing fading and degradation. While not pest-proof, a well-maintained, stained surface is less inviting for wood-boring insects.
acceptedAnswer.description: Staining protects against moisture, UV damage, and makes wood less attractive to pests.
